say:1:1731001001:1.text: Hey there! I can tell you have an eye for good stuff!
say:1:1731001001:1.source_cn: 哟！这位客人，眼神不错嘛！一看就是个行家！
say:1:1731001001:1.male: Hey there! I can tell you have an eye for good stuff!
say:1:1731001001:1.female: Hey there! I can tell you have an eye for good stuff!

say:2:1731001002:1.text: My place might not be much, but I've got Savannah's finest gear here!
say:2:1731001002:1.source_cn: 别看我这儿地方不大，但这赛凡纳最好的家伙事儿，可都在我...
say:2:1731001002:1.male: My place might not be much, but I've got Savannah's finest gear here!
say:2:1731001002:1.female: My place might not be much, but I've got Savannah's finest gear here!

say:3:1731001003:1.text: Are you looking for a handy weapon or a fine set of armor as a family heirloom?
say:3:1731001003:1.source_cn: 您是想找把趁手的兵器防身，还是想给自个儿换套能传家的铠甲？
say:3:1731001003:1.male: Are you looking for a handy weapon or a fine set of armor as a family heirloom?
say:3:1731001003:1.female: Are you looking for a handy weapon or a fine set of armor as a family heirloom?

say:4:1731001004:1.text: I'm sure you'll be happy with what you get! I'll give you the best price!
say:4:1731001004:1.source_cn: 只要您开口，我保证让您满意！价格嘛……嘿嘿，绝对公道！
say:4:1731001004:1.male: I'm sure you'll be happy with what you get! I'll give you the best price!
say:4:1731001004:1.female: I'm sure you'll be happy with what you get! I'll give you the best price!
